baseline: zero on first batch, previous batch mean moment_cost thereafter; independent of current random draws

actions.swap: fresh independent four-media emission from advanced episode RNG

continuation.calibration_scope: original registered scalar encoder validity only, no claim of natural-semantic calibration
continuation.control_mode: fast without forecasts; mandatory actual cold replay; 17 original kernels per episode
continuation.cpu_accounting: all measured self+child CPU; inherited native_cpu_seconds field includes FFmpeg children as well as native owner
continuation.cpu_gradient_model: observed CPU realization conditionally exogenous; estimate stochastic-action LR only; no direct parameter derivative through runtime
continuation.density: Gaussian fixed normalizers restored in helper; every actually executed conditional sample density appears once
extra_cpu_charges: every-episode public input tensor preparation, public digest, current-checkpoint/parameter hashes and policy manifest assembly
post-stop identity check, final physical readback and private scoring
continuation.fault: when declared in public scenario, truncate only initial generated video.mkv to eight bytes
continuation.native_decision: unchanged original readout on arrived public transport-integrity scalar; original expiry and host media-budget checks
continuation.parameter_update: only after K complete trajectories; each next episode verifies current checkpoint tensors, vocabulary and parameter hash
continuation.private_score_phase: only after owner closes, reopen final physical four files and apply frozen natural score
continuation.profile_binding_level: host receipts only; original native scope objective unchanged
continuation.public_feedback: +1 physical four-file integrity/readback success; -1 actual codec or declared video transport failure
continuation.stop: after actual native decision and optional admitted swap; maximum two emitted bundles
continuation.unbilled_setup_or_training: one-time corpus/model load, optimizer/backward, checkpoint writes and diagnostic JSON serialization reported separately; not deployment return; all per-episode input/policy preparation is charged
continuation.unexpected_computation_exception: abort entire diagnostic, never silently omit an episode; sampled codec/transport failures retained with zero gross utility

development_scenarios: first four training scenario types; four original development sources; no selection
joint_batch_reason: retains cross scores if measured costs couple trajectories; mean already divides K, no additional division

cost_scope: every-episode public input tensor preparation, public digest, current-checkpoint/parameter hashes and policy manifest assembly
post-stop identity check, final physical readback and private scoring
objective.cpu_gradient_model: observed CPU realization conditionally exogenous; estimate stochastic-action LR only; no direct parameter derivative through runtime

gross_score.image: exp(-10*mean squared RGB error after PNG reopen)
gross_score.semantic_gate: requires independent-source observer adequacy and generated action/sound agreement; reconstruction score alone never certifies natural semantic generation
gross_score.text: multiset token F1 over emitted UTF8 and official action/sound caption
gross_score.video: exp(-10*mean squared RGB error after FFV1 Matroska reopen)

scope: bounded mechanism proof of one new actual-trajectory profile, not a claim that prior profiles are identical or that original owner kernel parameters are trained
source_selection: first event from each of first distinct original split sources, before generating outcomes
